arguments.sql:
SELECT 
    p.ProductName, 
    c.CategoryName, 
    p.UnitsInStock, 
    p.ReorderLevel, 
    p.UnitsOnOrder, 
    p.UnitPrice,
    (p.ReorderLevel - p.UnitsInStock) AS UrgencyScore
FROM Products p
JOIN Categories c ON p.CategoryID = c.CategoryID
WHERE p.UnitsInStock <= p.ReorderLevel AND p.Discontinued = 0
ORDER BY UrgencyScore DESC;

    p.ProductName, 
    s.CompanyName AS SupplierName, 
    p.UnitsInStock, 
    p.ReorderLevel, 
    p.UnitsOnOrder, 
    p.UnitPrice,
    ((p.ReorderLevel * 2) - p.UnitsInStock - p.UnitsOnOrder) AS RecommendedQty
FROM Products p
JOIN Suppliers s ON p.SupplierID = s.SupplierID
WHERE p.UnitsInStock <= p.ReorderLevel AND p.Discontinued = 0;
